_about: Experimental design. Core: full factorial acuity x load x configuration (27 ED types) with boarding 'low' and diagnostic intensity 'typical'. Boarding and diagnostic intensity are varied one at a time on the medium-load types (sensitivity).

POOLED.label: Pooled
POOLED.description: one treatment area, one physician pool

FASTTRACK.label: Fast track
FASTTRACK.description: Main area plus a fast-track area with its own spaces and physicians; a fast-track patient may take an idle Main space when no Main patient is waiting

SPLITFLOW.label: Split flow
SPLITFLOW.description: Main beds plus a vertical area of chairs held only during physician encounters; one shared physician pool; admitted vertical patients board in a Main bed

second_area_share_basis: offered space load of CTAS 4-5 patients
